TIP #1
Match Trial Participants with Peer Mentors at Enrollment — Not After They Drop Out
25% of clinical trial participants drop out after consenting. The gap between "yes" and "first visit" is where anxiety peaks and confidence falls. Connecting participants with a trained mentor — someone who's completed the same trial — builds trust before doubt sets in. Programs using AI-powered matching see 92% retention vs. 57% with manual methods.
